cards.description: Login and permission logic for this module.

children.title: Route Guards
children.description: A route guard checks a condition (e.g. is the user logged in) before a route is allowed to load.

notes.text: Functional guards (CanActivateFn) need no NgModule providers — inject() just works.
Returning false blocks navigation silently. Redirect to a login route instead of leaving a blank screen.

children.title: Dependency Injection
children.description: A service registered with providedIn: 'root' becomes a singleton that can be injected into guards and components.
